items.title: Amazon Prime Air maybe coming to a city near you
items.summary: Amazon (AMZN) is taking Prime Air to the next level. The tech and retail giant plans to expand its drone delivery service to nearly 500 U.S. cities and towns by the end of 2026, roughly a sixfold increase over its current footprint. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to break down Amazon’s drone delivery ambitions and what customers can expect as Prime Air expands to tens of millions of people.

items.title: 6 Big Takeaways From Retail’s Big Week of Earnings
items.summary: Walmart  set a somber tone for the first week of retailer earnings, but that wasn’t the whole story.  The big news was  Walmart’s  sales woes as the Bentonville, Ark.-based giant reported a same-store sales decline—the first since 2020.  Target  meanwhile, showed some signs of life, reflecting its turnaround efforts.

items.title: Walmart Stock Is Having Its Worst Day in Years. Here’s What’s to Blame.
items.summary: Walmart  stock is having its worst day in over four years on Thursday as lower drug prices resulting from federal regulations passed during the Biden administration put a damper on same-store sales.  While the changes were expected, the impact on  Walmart’s  overall sales growth was greater than anticipated.  Walmart is currently the second-biggest loser in the  for the day.

items.title: Walmart reports mixed results as gas prices drag on US sales growth
items.summary: Walmart reported mixed results Thursday, topping analyst estimates but experiencing slower US sales growth as consumers contended with lofty gasoline prices due to the US-Iran war.Adding to the hit from the new pharma price rules, Walmart also experienced slower growth in the second quarter in sales of GLP-1 diabetes and weight loss products.
